preprocessing: Select the bounded route feature from a FeatureServer/query response.
Flatten the physically longest polyline path by measured segment distance into a single WGS84 track for Cesium entities.
Preserve source Z values when terrain sampling is disabled.
Derive playback timestamps from cumulative segment distance because no route time field is present.
limitations: The fixture is deterministic for CI and local review. Live mode still requires a user-supplied Honua server and line layer.
No terrain tiles are bundled in this repo. Optional terrain still depends on a user-supplied Cesium terrain URL or ion token.
